title: Sales Certification Program: How to Prove Reps Are Ready to Sell
summary: Build a sales certification program that proves reps can run the call: knowledge checks, scored simulations, live-call review, and recertification.
body_markdown:
Field


What to decide


Example: mid-market AE


Certification name


The work it unlocks


Cleared for first discovery and pricing calls


Call type


One conversation per task


Pricing conversation with an economic buyer


Evidence level


Knowledge, practice, or live


Practice, then one live call


Scenario


Buyer role, posture, private facts, objections


CFO, guarded, asks for a discount tied to a two-year term


Critical criteria


Behaviors that fail the task if missed


Confirms decision process; no unapproved discount


Graded criteria and scale


Skills with levels, each value defined


Ties price to the buyer's business case, 1/3/5


Pass rule


Minimum score and number of passes, or all critical criteria


Score 8 of 10 on two attempts


Scorer


Who grades and who reviews


Scorecard grading, manager reviews the live call


Retry rule


What the rep repeats after a miss


Retry the missed moment, then one full attempt


Record


What the certificate links to


Each passing attempt, its score, and the cited moments


Recertification trigger


What reopens the task


Pricing change, new packaging, or a live-call miss on a critical criterion
